metadata.title: Build an engine derived from an existing runtime

applicability.scope: Development and qualification of an engine that retains an upstream execution core.
applicability.input_contract: Actual hardware, model, engine, script and flags, benchmark, acceptance criteria, current diagnosis, permitted changes and budget.
applicability.produced_artifact: Parent/fork behavior matrix, bounded extension and matched end-to-end results.
applicability.refusal_point: Record missing evidence or an exhausted search budget and identify the smallest discriminating test before declaring success.

limitations: The cards describe routes and acceptance evidence; hardware support and task success require separate validation.

body.json.text:
{
  "task": "derived-engine",
  "title": "Build an engine derived from an existing runtime",
  "choose_when": "The deliverable reuses the execution core of vLLM, vLLM-Omni or another pinned parent, as in a DeepInfer-like extension.",
  "required_inputs": [
    "parent repository, revision and retained modules",
    "delta in model or scheduling contract",
    "target hardware and workload",
    "reference parent behavior"
  ],
  "steps": [
    "Identify inherited execution paths and replacement seams.",
    "Define compatibility for configuration, responses and state ownership.",
    "Compare outputs and performance to the pinned parent on the same inputs."
  ],
  "acceptance_evidence": "A runnable derived-engine slice, a parent-versus-fork delta and reproducible parity/benchmark results.",
  "candidate_skill_ids": [
    "repository-evolution-analysis",
    "bound-windowed-attention-replay",
    "budget-speculative-verification",
    "inference-benchmark-design"
  ]
}
